page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 64 vCPUs derived from 32 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Built on KVM hypervisor technology and x86_64 architecture, it delivers 256 GB of dedicated System RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction set support includes AVX-512 VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI extensions. The instance includes a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates without dedicated GPUs, and provides no bundled local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark results highlight strong multi-threaded performance, ranking in the top 25% across tests such as multi-core stress-ng, PassMark CPU, Geekbench multi-core, and software compilation with Clang. In addition, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, CPU encryption benchmarks, and PassMark database operations yield top-quartile results. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng single-core execution, Geekbench single-core, and gzip compression, perform within the middle 50% average range. Memory throughput tests show an uncached read bandwidth of 170.68 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 69.67 GB/sec.

By pairing 64 dedicated virtual cores with 256 GB memory, the server delivers high multi-threaded compute density and cost efficiency for parallelized processing without the price premium of specialized high-memory tiers. The principal tradeoff is the absence of local storage, which requires external block storage attachment and relies heavily on the 32 Gbps network interface. Recommended workload fits include multi-threaded software compilation, parallel data processing, database servers utilizing remote block volumes, containerized microservices, and small-scale LLM inference processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz with 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores and 256 GB of RAM. With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation, this server offers efficient resource density for parallel compute tasks, database operations, software building, and container orchestration.
